title: The Explanation of the New Bell Schedule
youtube_title: The Explanation of the New Bell Schedule | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet attention can be warmer than advice.
summary: At a porch while rain ticks and nobody is late, Nana Ruth begins to tell Esme about a new bell schedule with one exception at the end. Esme wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
